name: Lumo
tagline: Privacy-first AI assistant with zero-access encrypted chats.
description: Lumo is Proton's privacy-focused AI assistant. Conversations are protected with zero-access encryption and decrypt only on your device, with no server-side logs and nothing used for model training. It runs on open-source language models hosted in Proton's European datacenters, and the app itself is open source. Free to use without an account; Lumo Plus adds unlimited chats and larger uploads.
insight: From Proton (Proton Mail/VPN); chats use zero-access encryption and run on open-source models in EU datacenters, never used for training.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on open-weight models hosted in Proton's EU datacenters; no model picker.

edge: A genuinely private chatbot — open-source, zero-access-encrypted, EU-hosted, with no logging or training on your data — from the maker of Proton Mail.
pros: No logs; data not used for training
cons: Open models lag the top frontier LLMs

references.title: I tried Proton's privacy-focused AI and the results were disappointing
